exact_statement: Retains v3/v4 with their original scopes and extends them: for all real a,b, L(a,b)<=2|ab|, hence the exact scalar binary-activation erasure remainder satisfies R_r<=6r|beta|<=6r Inf_i(w) for every disjoint Boolean pair, including deterministic means. OR/AND of any finite number of disjoint such products admits a K10-good continuation after every physical stopping prefix, adding zero K10-bad odd-face debit; earlier debit and both full terminal entropies remain. For every Boolean f, coordinate i and T not containing i, let a=fhat(T), b=fhat(T+i), d=Inf_i(f), W=(1-d-a^2)(d-b^2). Then B_i<=L(a,b)+2sqrt(W)<=2d+2sqrt(W); this gives the exact localized tree liability in DERIVATION(7), whose universal O(I) price remains unproved. No paid reference is reset. Entropy corollaries H<=7I for products and H<=13I for the stated OR/AND class use inherited B05 localization. Arbitrary general-edit residuals, old-prefix payment, general outer gates and full FEI remain open.
